Earlier in the week, the national debt hit a record high of $40 trillion, five months after eclipsing $39 trillion. For context, the U.S. debt balance was $28.4 trillion in late 2021. Fast-rising national debt erodes trust in the U.S. dollar and raises borrowing costs.
